scenarios.name: First local start
scenarios.evidence: Packaged server starts offline with a disposable local ledger.

scenarios.name: Plan materialization
scenarios.evidence: Setup returns at least four tasks and the first task is active.

scenarios.name: Invalid model dependencies
scenarios.evidence: Reference core test 2; no stable public API accepts raw model-plan dependencies.

scenarios.name: Provider secret custody
scenarios.evidence: Reference core test 3; ciphertext-at-rest assertion requires filesystem observation.

scenarios.name: Compatible migration
scenarios.evidence: Reference core test 4; no migration request endpoint exists.

scenarios.name: Derived progress
scenarios.evidence: Reference core test 5 and local completion smoke.

scenarios.name: Explicit false proof
scenarios.evidence: False submission remains active and releases no coins.

scenarios.name: Concrete relevant proof
scenarios.evidence: Concrete evidence passes the reference deterministic gate.

scenarios.name: Proposal honesty
scenarios.evidence: Mutation-shaped language yields a formal pending proposal.

scenarios.name: No preview mutation
scenarios.evidence: Task count is unchanged before confirmation.

scenarios.name: Atomic confirmation
scenarios.evidence: Valid confirmation executes the proposal and returns a receipt; failure atomicity remains source-suite evidence.

scenarios.name: Sealed-history protection
scenarios.evidence: Specified by CONSTELLARY-EXCHANGE.md; no dedicated reference API fixture or named test.

scenarios.name: AI second opinion
scenarios.evidence: Concrete proof opens a two-reviewer audit contract.

scenarios.name: Reward escrow
scenarios.evidence: Before quorum the task is unverified and coins remain zero.

scenarios.name: Rejecting review
scenarios.evidence: Specified by the federation documentation; the frozen tests exercise approval, not a rejecting quorum correction cycle.

scenarios.name: Single settlement
scenarios.evidence: The matrix explicitly says the successor strengthens reference behavior; v0.4.0 has no separate settlement command or replay receipt.

scenarios.name: Progression
scenarios.evidence: Approved reference review releases coins and progression.

scenarios.name: Harmless delight
scenarios.evidence: Successful verification creates a Field Specimen.

scenarios.name: Endless horizon
scenarios.evidence: Completion yields three choices and one appends chapter two.

scenarios.name: Identity portability
scenarios.evidence: Encrypted capsule preserves DID and earned coins; a wrong passphrase fails inertly.

scenarios.name: Federation independence
scenarios.evidence: Two nodes have distinct root identifiers, ledgers, and reviewer identities.

scenarios.name: Signed tamper detection
scenarios.evidence: A linked fake peer's tampered signed record is rejected and remains inert.

scenarios.name: Independent audit quorum
scenarios.evidence: Policy requires two assigned signed opinions before approval.

scenarios.name: Imported text is inert
scenarios.evidence: Documented federation boundary; no dedicated malicious-text reference fixture.

scenarios.name: Founding Commons
scenarios.evidence: The three-house Founding Commons smoke test passes in the frozen full suite.

scenarios.name: Content removable
scenarios.evidence: The reference hard-codes Founding Commons behavior and has no pack removal contract.

scenarios.name: Renderer equivalence
scenarios.evidence: The reference has one product presentation, not three renderer profiles over a shared contract.

scenarios.name: Failure truthfulness
scenarios.evidence: README promises retry/disconnection rather than demo substitution; storage-outage behavior lacks a dedicated frozen test.
